input.quote: The Terminal Parties hereby grant to the Parties accessing APCN 2 at their respective terminal station, the right of use in the relevant Segment T (hereinafter referred to as \"Terminal Station Right of Use\") on the terms and conditions stated in this Paragraph 11, to the extent required for the use of its Allocated Capacity
input.rationale: The grant analogue is the Terminal Station Right of Use in Subparagraph 11.1, which runs for the duration of the Agreement (25-year Initial Period) and is not revocable at the Terminal Parties' discretion, so this is not walk-away territory. Fallback element 2 is already satisfied: Subparagraph 22.3(a) permits a Party at any time to assign the whole of its rights and obligations to a successor of that Party, with written notice under 22.6. Fallback element 1 fails, however: the 11.1 grant runs only to the Parties, and the only affiliate paths (12.8 use of WAC, 12.14 transfer of Allocated Capacity) are not written-notice coverage at all - they are conditioned on the Affiliate being a Carrier and on a cash contribution to the upgrade fund, and they do not touch the Segment T right of use. We therefore make the single shortest fallback edit, extending the 11.1 grant to a Party's Affiliates on written notice to the relevant Terminal Party. Preferred sub-elements (contractors acting on our behalf, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence) are noted but not pursued, since the fallback is the acceptable position here.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Extend the Terminal Station Right of Use grant to a Party's Affiliates on written notice
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Terminal Station Right of Use to a Party's Affiliates upon written notice to the relevant Terminal Party, which is our fallback licence-scope position; transfer to a successor is already permitted under Subparagraph 22.3(a).
